text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"It's finally here: the Arima Kinen. Man, 
the whole place is in full-on festival 
mode."
choice_data_list:
Nice Nature's phone was buzzing like crazy 
too.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha~, sorry for all the noise. My 
messages just won't stop coming, no matter 
what I do.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
When I opened my emails just now, there 
were already dozens of them piled up.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
When I looked, they were all clumsy 
messages of support. Just a bunch of old 
folks who only recently learned how to 
text.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Stuff like 'Good luck seeing as I'm in the 
fulture'— it's misspelled and way too 
simple...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Every single message ended with 'blah-blah 
Shopping Arcade.' Even the folks from 
Kokura went out of their way to contact 
me.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...It's because everyone cheered me on 
like that that I'm able to stand here 
right now.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Saying "thank you" is still a little 
embarrassing, but...
choice_data_list:
Then I'll give you a victory as a present 
instead.

Then I'll give you a victory as a present 
instead.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, hold up! What you're asking in 
return is way too heavy!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, for someone as cynical as me, I 
guess I gotta put in that much effort.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"If I win today's race, do you think I can 
become the main character too?"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if the day will come when I can 
say I shine just as brightly as Teio...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Immediate reply! Full of vigor as always, 
I see...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. But well... I'll gladly accept it 
today.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Because just having the mindset of 'trying 
hard' isn't going to get me any results.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For Nice Nature right now, the Arima 
Kinen, packed with strong Umamusume from 
every generation, will surely be a massive 
challenge.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even so!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Ooh, this time of day... might just be 
the most thrilling—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
—Ryan. Let us have a match. Let us settle 
which of us is stronger.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'm coming at you with everything 
I've got!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hm, those two are...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I shall give it my all as well. 
Elegantly, beautifully... I will claim 
victory over you.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
(Mejiro McQueen. Hailing from the 
prestigious Mejiro family, she's the 
strongest stayer who debuted before me.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Heheh... I don't care if it's messy and 
unrefined. I'm gonna tear that victory 
away with brute force!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
(Mejiro Ryan. Like McQueen, she's from the 
Mejiro family—a senpai whose charm lies in 
her bright, powerful energy.)

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...Is the whole world full of nothing but 
sparkling people? Well, I guess that's 
obvious being at Tracen Academy."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"If a background character ended up 
winning in the middle of all that, 
though... it'd be pretty entertaining, 
don't you think?"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay. We've done everything we can. 
We'll win on this grand stage and—"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I'm going to answer everyone's cheers!
